info.name: Select Star Metadata bi terms API

params.name: collections
params.description: A comma separated list of collection guids, for to filter the collection items from

params.name: order
params.description:
Specify the ordering for the results. 

 A comma separated list for ordering by multiple fields and a preceding `-` indicates reverse order. 

Note: Order is case-sensitive.

params.name: owners
params.description: A comma separated list of user or team guids to filter for objects within these users as owners (technical or business).

params.name: page
params.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: search_business_owner
params.description: Search for an asset using business owner name

params.name: search_collections
params.description: Search for an asset using a collection name

params.name: search_description
params.description: A search term.

params.name: search_name
params.description: Search for an asset using its name

params.name: search_tag_name
params.description: Search for an asset using a tag name

params.name: search_technical_owner
params.description: Search for an asset using technical owner name

params.name: teams
params.description: A comma separated list of team guids to filter for tables owned by users of those teams.

params.name: updated_on
params.description:
Filter objects by updated_on. May specify __gt, __gte, __lt or __lte.

 API call to: 

 ENDPOINT/updated_on__gt=2021-08-04T15:12:40&updated_on__lt=2021-08-23 

 will result with objects updated_on after  August 4th 2021 at 15:12:40, but before August 23rd 2021. 

. If you want to include lower or upper bound of the range use __gte or __lte respectively.
